card.name: Verbs after drug exposure measures
card.fires_on: The linking word or verb right after a drug name or exposure measure like AUC or Cmax, where the sentence is about to say the level was increased or reduced. Mostly in drug interaction sections.

modes.label: Verb after AUC
modes.description: The verb (was, are, increased) that follows a drug's AUC or mean exposure.
modes.example: The mean systemic exposure (AUC) of etravirine<< was>> reduced when etravirine tablets

modes.label: Linking word in AUC phrase
modes.description: The word "of" or a verb inside a phrase about Cmax and AUC of a named drug.
modes.example: The mean C max and AUC<< of>> propranolol are increased, respectively

modes.label: Other drug-effect wording
modes.description: Scattered words inside drug names or effect phrases in interaction text.
modes.example: plasma level monitoring for<< dig>>oxin is recommended.

card.plain: It marks the spot in a drug interaction sentence where the text is about to say a drug's blood level went up or down.
